Peter Coad

American software entrepreneur

Peter Coad is a software entrepreneur and author of books on software architecture and design. He is notable for his role in defining what have come to be known as the UML colors, a color-coded notation chiefly useful for adding breadth and depth to a design, using four major archetypes.
